name: exo
readme_excerpt: exo: Run frontier AI locally. Maintained by exo labs. exo connects all your devices into an AI cluster. Not only does exo enable running models larger than would fit on a single device, but with day-0 support for RDMA over Thunderbolt, makes models run faster as you add more devices.
